description: This file contains styles related to a 'focused' mode, including media queries for responsiveness, class definitions for layout and transition effects, and keyframe animations for fade-in and fade-out effects.

classes.name: .focus-mode
classes.description: A CSS class that applies styles for the focused mode, including layout adjustments and transition effects.

classes.name: .disable-focus-mode
classes.description: A CSS class that overrides focus mode styles to revert or reduce the focus mode effects.

methods.name: @keyframes fade-in
methods.description: Defines the animation for fading elements in by changing opacity from 0 to 1.

methods.name: @keyframes fade-out
methods.description: Defines the animation for fading elements out by changing opacity from 1 to 0.
